description: This file defines the EmailAuthenticateUser class which extends the SugarAuthenticateUser class to implement email-based user authentication for the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM platform. It handles login sessions, generates email tokens, and sends session tokens via email.

classes.name: EmailAuthenticateUser
classes.description: A class that manages email-based user authentication, including login validation, token generation, and email notification.

methods.name: loadUserOnLogin
methods.description: Handles user login using email tokens, validates credentials, generates session tokens, and manages session state.

methods.name: sendEmailPassword
methods.description: Fetches user's email data from the database and sends the authentication token via email.
